name: @algomaker/desk-engine
description: The recenter supervisor's decision engine: canonical two-sided market/leg/state types, the desk-api wire contract, the NSE session grid and the dial schema. Pure, no clock, no IO.
_comment:exports: The two leaf modules are exported on their own path FOR THE BROWSER. apps/web renders the dials panel from DIAL_SECTIONS and prefills from PRESETS, and importing those through '.' would drag the whole engine — marking, shed, shift and @algomaker/greeks — into the dashboard bundle for one metadata table. dials.ts imports nothing and presets.ts imports one type from it, so these two paths carry no graph at all. Every server-side consumer keeps importing '.'.
_comment:session: ./session is the leaf NSE calendar, exported so @algomaker/venue can read the holiday list without importing '.', which imports venue back.
